project_type: Vite 6 + React 18 + TypeScript + TanStack Router + Convex backend + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui
build_system: bun (npm is NOT available). Uses vite for bundling, tsc for type checking.
test_framework: vitest with jsdom (but jsdom/bun incompatibility in sandbox - TypeScript build is the verification)
verification_instructions: 1. bun run build must pass (tsc && vite build). 2. bun run lint must not go above 71 problems.
environment_constraints: bun only - no npm. jsdom/bun incompatibility means vitest may not run. TypeScript build passing is the main verification.
contribution_requirements: Single commit: feat: detail page re-hero with gauge-first layout and data-coloured cards (#44). Branch: feat/r4-detail-rehero from main. Do NOT modify Convex backend. Do NOT rewrite WaterLevelGauge.tsx from scratch.
key_patterns: cn() utility for conditional classnames. Colors defined as CSS vars in globals.css, exposed via tailwind config (alert, warning, danger, normal). text-water-level CSS class in globals.css. AlertLevelBadge component for status display. ExpandableSection for collapsible content.
directory_structure: src/components/ - UI components. src/routes/ - TanStack Router pages (stations/$id.tsx is the detail page). src/styles/globals.css - global styles. src/hooks/ - custom hooks. src/lib/ - utils. src/utils/ - utilities. convex/ - backend (DO NOT MODIFY). tailwind.config.ts - theme colors.
